item.tib: zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying thig kye ma'i zab gcod lag len shel dkar phreng ba'i do shal
item.coloph: ces pas snying thig kye ma'i gsang gcod kyi lag len 'di ltar dgos zhes rtse drug mtshams pa gling zhig gdung rigs rnam dag don ldan dang / dpal ri mtshams pa g.yung drung rnam dag a mdo bla ma tshul khrims rnam dag nye gnas mkha' 'gro dbang mo/ mchog rgyal/ lhun grub/ dpal rdo/ a bstan sogs kyi (kyis) bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas bris pa dge gyur cig
